verdict.rationale: Cake ships some fixed event-driven automations: it can automatically notify your registered agent on share issuances, transfers or conversions, and its vesting engine and approval flows automate cliffs, schedules and sign-offs. There is no evidence of a user-configurable rules or trigger engine, and the MCP integration is read-only, so it cannot drive actions. Missing for 10: user-defined rules/conditions, configurable event triggers and custom actions, webhooks or an API for event automation (no OpenAPI spec found), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
